message.content: {"note_claim": "UK council tax law has no provision allowing homeowners to avoid council tax by using rooms for private prayer, so the claimed exemption does not exist.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "These claims have no basis in council tax law. It is not possible for owners of domestic property to avoid council tax by claiming that their property, or part of it, is used for religious purposes.", "reason": "The Full Fact page rates the identical claim false and quotes the House of Commons Library stating that council tax law has no such exemption."}

parsed.note_claim: UK council tax law has no provision allowing homeowners to avoid council tax by using rooms for private prayer, so the claimed exemption does not exist.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: These claims have no basis in council tax law. It is not possible for owners of domestic property to avoid council tax by claiming that their property, or part of it, is used for religious purposes.
parsed.reason: The Full Fact page rates the identical claim false and quotes the House of Commons Library stating that council tax law has no such exemption.
